If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days and forecast peaks mid-horizon, reduce peak by 2–5% to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast shows strong upward trend, cap upward movement at 1–3% above recent high to prevent overcorrection.  
If sentiment is 0.67–0.33 and forecast diverges >3% from true path in late horizon, apply downward bias of 1–4% to align with sentiment decay.  
If sentiment spikes to 1.00 and forecast is flat or declining, add 1–3% upward bias to reflect bullish momentum.  
If sentiment is 0.00 and forecast is rising, reduce forecast by 2–5% to reflect lack of conviction.  
If sentiment is 0.67 and forecast is falling, add 1–3% upward bias to counteract sentiment-induced pessimism.
